Hero_Desc_Makasha:
Belitien's strategist. She was reportedly once one of the three witches who represented the court.
Her rambling manner of speech makes that difficult to believe.
She seems to live idly with her pet house Baba, but remains surprisingly busy scheming one thing or another.
Album_Wish_Makasha: To properly mend the past she designed to go astray
Album_Makasha1: Makasha is a mysterious witch who lived hidden in a remote forest. After a long search, I finally found her. She greeted me with a mystical air and stared as though she had known everything all along. But then...
Album_Makasha2: Makasha is a capable and perfectly normal witch. As long as she keeps her mouth shut. She speaks in such a strange way that conversations with her leave the mind reeling.
Album_Makasha3: Makasha was reportedly once one of three witches who represented the Witch Court alongside Fricle and Sherum. A series of events drove her from the court to a remote forest. At least, that is what Fricle told me.
Album_Makasha4: Makasha treated an injured native Elias species known as a 'house monster' and now lives inside it. It resembles a house with legs. She gave it the cute name Baba. Makasha remained impossible to locate for so long because this house monster constantly changes its position.
Album_Makasha5: Makasha intervened in many events throughout Elias's past and exerted considerable influence. Brilliant and skilled in magical combat, she makes a dependable ally once on your side. You simply have to endure her incomprehensibly eccentric personality.
Album_Makasha6: Makasha wonders whether the past events she 'designed' were truly right. Was it right to guide another's fate in the direction she desired? Her true intentions and methods may have been rough, but what decision would I have made in her place?
Album_Makasha7: Watching the evening sunset from atop Makasha's home was a wonderful experience. We silently admired the crimson sky for some time. Makasha improvised a drink for me, and I regretted drinking it. She had given me a stimulant so I could listen to her stories all night.
LoveHero_Makasha: Ehehe. I knew you would choose me.
LoveHeroCancel_Makasha: Hmm? This is a future I did not foresee.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Hate1: She flew into a rage after one bite, demanding to know who made such food. It was frightening when she declared its creator should be hung upside down.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Hate2: After one bite, she said it made her head hurt and asked who could possibly eat such a thing. Then she apparently thought of someone and became irritated.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Like1: She loved that it was both healthy and convenient. Judging by her question about making a large batch at once, she truly meant it.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Like2: Marveling at the technology of an exotic species, she intensely studied how it could have been made. She could at least have taken a sip...
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Like3: She called the texture fascinating and ate them one by one, then fell silent and concentrated on eating. She must have liked them. What a relief.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Like4: She frowned and said she disliked sweets, but after tasting the bittersweet flavor, she began eating while continuing to complain.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Like5: She was delighted that the tart powder seemed tasty with anything. When I asked why she packed some away, she said it was for Baba.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Like6: She marveled at the familiar texture and entirely different flavor, then ate eagerly. Her request for takeout showed how much she liked it.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Like7: She said sugar was necessary when writing a new story and that this was perfect for such moments.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Like8: Her eyes shone as she said it would be perfect sprinkled over fried carrots whenever she lacked vitamins. I am unsure whether that is true, but decided to accept her word.
Food_ChefNote_Makasha_Like9: After staring at the candy, she suddenly began grinning and chewing. It was a little... no, very frightening. That means she liked it, right...?
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Makasha: What if our meeting was no coincidence?
Gacha_Result_Line1_Makasha: A predetermined fate? Do you truly believe that? Ehehe~
Makasha_Spawn1: E-hehe. This meeting was inevitable too.
Makasha_Spawn2: Shall we go write a new fate...?
Makasha_Growth: Curious about me? My name is Makasha! Hehehe!
Makasha_Growth1: Is it time to write a new story?
Makasha_Growth2: To defy destiny, I must become stronger.
Makasha_Victory1: Ehehe. We were destined to win~
Makasha_Victory2: You ask whether I knew? Of course I did! Ehehe!
Makasha_Defeat2: I never wrote a story like this!
Makasha_Affinity1_2: This is a little different from the plan. Ehehe, but I need only find another way.
Makasha_Affinity2: Have you seen Baba? Hmm~ Perhaps she went for a walk?
Makasha_Affinity1_3: Hmm. Was I mistaken? No. This too must be part of the flow.
Makasha_Affinity3: You read the book I hid? Ehehe. So, where is your book report? You did not write one?
Makasha_Affinity4: Sometimes, I think giving up can be a good method. If you wish not to give up, that is. What do I mean? Ehehe.
Makasha_Affinity5: No matter who you are, it is your hidden intentions that matter. Would you not agree?
Makasha_Affinity6: Let us think again. Rearrange everything, and turn coincidence into inevitability.
Makasha_Affinity7: You fascinate me. Watching you inspires such wonderful stories!
Makasha_Die2: Is there... no way to resist fate...?
Makasha_LevelUp: Is it time to write a new story?

Makasha_HeroUpgrade: Not bad. This feels pretty good.
Makasha_DeckSetting2: This is a good place to glimpse fate.
Makasha_Stage: This is the first step toward the inevitable.
Makasha_Touch1_1: Now this is a story I never imagined!
Makasha_Touch1_2: Are you not afraid of fate?!
Makasha_DutchRubEnd2: What do you think you are doing?!

Makasha_Growth1_Skin1: Did you think of a new menu?
Makasha_Growth2_Skin1: Can I cook even faster now?
Makasha_LevelUp_Skin1: I am getting closer and closer to my goal.

Makasha_Board_Skin1: Did an order slip fall over there?

Makasha_Touch2_1_Skin1: Be careful not to get sauce on me.
Makasha_Touch2_2_Skin1: Oho? Are you not afraid of what I am holding?
Makasha_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: You made me burn the patty!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Makasha_Skin2: Remembering her exhausting and eventful past, Makasha enjoys a hot spring bath with a more languid expression than ever.
Makasha_Growth2_Skin2: I feel as though I might drift away like a heat haze.
Makasha_LevelUp_Skin2: E-hehe! Fit the ball in, tong-tong!
Makasha_Equipment_Skin2: You are getting me a towel? Mm~ Nice!
Makasha_HeroSkill_Skin2: This is harder than it looks, I tell you. I have to practice hard!
Makasha_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: If I stay here any longer, I think I will melt~
Makasha_Board_Skin2: I think that spot over there will be warmer.
Makasha_Touch1_Skin2: What is with this cold-bath tugging?
Makasha_Touch1_1_Skin2: Hey! I am enjoying some peace and quiet!
Makasha_Touch1_2_Skin2: Do you want an empty head?
Makasha_Touch2_Skin2: Want to soak our feet together~?
Makasha_Touch2_1_Skin2: Ah~ This feels so good~ All my fatigue is gone~!
Makasha_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Do you want to be gored by my horns?!
Makasha_AsideGet: All right! With this mortar, I am a real 'Mortar Witch' too!
Makasha_AsideUpgrade: Let us fly! Mortar! Let us fly! E-hehe!
Makasha_PowerAttack1: Shall I tell you your fate?
Makasha_Sorrow2: Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh...
Makasha_Birthday: Happy birthday. As a present, I will tell you an interesting story.
Makasha_Gacha2: A predetermined fate? Do you really believe that?
Makasha_Gacha3: Hehehehe, if meeting me was no coincidence.
Makasha_Line1: Fate is not set in stone.
Makasha_Line2: I have to untangle these knotted threads. I can do it.
Makasha_Line3: Shall we make a magnificent mess?
Makasha_Lobby: Hm-hmm, this is part of the story's flow too.
LoveLetter_Makasha:
Ehehe! Long-Limbs. Thank you for showing me around Monatium before. Thinking back, I have received quite a few small favors, including meals in the banquet hall.

Lately I have wondered whether the two of us could call each other friends. Friends help each other, so tell me whenever you need my assistance. I will send a small gift to commemorate our friendship. I hope you like it! Ehehe!
LoveCall_Makasha:
Hmm, are we connected?
Ehehe! Long-Limbs. It is me, Makasha, the greatest intellect among witches.
Nothing happened. I simply decided to call.
Since we are speaking, I realize I rarely tell you how grateful I am.
Even without my saying it, you know I am always grateful to you, Long-Limbs, right?
Hmm? You did not know? Come now, is this how things are between us? How disappointing~ If you did not know, remember it well.

Ah, Baba has wanted to see you lately.
So when you have time, why not visit and clean Baba's floor?
I am absolutely not calling because I cannot be bothered to clean.
I mean it. Baba wants to see you, Long-Limbs.
While you are here, you can also have a cup of tea with me. Take care~ Long-Limbs!
Affinity_Makasha_EP01_003: No. I just thought of an entertaining plan.
Affinity_Makasha_EP01_004: Try changing that laugh. It gives me the creeps.
Affinity_Makasha_EP01_005: No. Did you contribute anything to my laughter? I should laugh even louder. E-ehehehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP01_006: What is it? Let me laugh with you.
Affinity_Makasha_EP01_007: It is a rather long story. You are better off not knowing. Sometimes ignorance truly is bliss.
Affinity_Makasha_EP02_001: Is there nothing you are curious to know about me?
Affinity_Makasha_EP02_002: Your skin is rather pale for a witch, is it not?
Affinity_Makasha_EP02_003: There are pale witches too. Assuming all witches have dark skin is a prejudice.
Affinity_Makasha_EP02_004: Why are you nicknamed the Mortar Witch?
Affinity_Makasha_EP02_005: I suppose this thing I carry looked like a mortar. I personally rather like the nickname. It sounds strong.
Affinity_Makasha_EP02_006: Between you and Fricle, who is stronger?
Affinity_Makasha_EP02_007: Who knows? I have never thought deeply about it. We are probably evenly matched.
Affinity_Makasha_EP03_001: Lizard tail, striped mushroom, dark-red carrot, and... what else...
Affinity_Makasha_EP03_002: More nonsense, I see. She was such a fine witch once... What a pity.
Affinity_Makasha_EP03_003: It is not nonsense! This is my shopping list for today!
Affinity_Makasha_EP03_004: Add dewdrop petals to it too!
Affinity_Makasha_EP03_005: Oh? That is the recipe for lizard-tail mushroom salad. How did you know? Hmm? You learned from making so many bizarre dishes?
Affinity_Makasha_EP03_006: Are you still suffering from the medicine's side effects...?
Affinity_Makasha_EP03_007: Taking medicine that erased my memories did not damage my brain!
Affinity_Makasha_EP04_001: I returned to the Witch Kingdom after so long, and quite a lot had changed.
Affinity_Makasha_EP04_002: It must feel as though you traveled through time.
Affinity_Makasha_EP04_003: If I were going to travel through time, I would rather have gone to the past~ I might have prevented the catastrophe too. What a shame.
Affinity_Makasha_EP04_004: It is all right. You can adapt little by little.
Affinity_Makasha_EP04_005: Then make sure you help me from nearby. I would also like you to prepare plenty of delicious food, like today.
Affinity_Makasha_EP04_006: Shall I introduce you to a friend around your age? Her name is Joanne.
Affinity_Makasha_EP04_007: You mean that Sprite who tells those strange jokes. She was preparing to publish a joke book, though I have no idea whether that will work out.
Affinity_Makasha_EP05_001: Do you not think Baba is rather cute too?
Affinity_Makasha_EP05_002: Baba is cute, but why is she named Baba?
Affinity_Makasha_EP05_003: It rolls right off the tongue. Baba! Baa~baa~! Ehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP05_004: I want to put hot sauce on Baba's chicken feet!
Affinity_Makasha_EP05_005: W-what is that look for? Baba must be protected!
Affinity_Makasha_EP05_007: Yes! That is it! Baba is still Baba backward! Ehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP06_002: That happens to everyone at your age.
Affinity_Makasha_EP06_003: That makes me feel strangely conflicted... The more I think about it, the angrier I get.
Affinity_Makasha_EP06_004: Why not buy some notepaper and write things down?
Affinity_Makasha_EP06_005: But that is such a nuisance. I should practice improving my memory instead.
Affinity_Makasha_EP06_006: How nice. It works like medicine without your even having to take any.
Affinity_Makasha_EP06_007: You are teasing me, are you not? That was not a bad joke. Ehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP07_001: Witches these days truly have no respect for their elders~
Affinity_Makasha_EP07_002: I heard the same thing was written on an ancient mural.
Affinity_Makasha_EP07_003: Perhaps it is a venerable tradition passed down from antiquity. Ehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP07_004: You were away for so long that they probably do not know who you are.
Affinity_Makasha_EP07_005: True, I was in seclusion long enough for the landscape itself to change. When I think about it, that is only natural.
Affinity_Makasha_EP07_006: It must mean you look that young. Try to see the bright side.
Affinity_Makasha_EP07_007: Can you not sense a dignity in me that those young witches lack? What? Why are you laughing?
Affinity_Makasha_EP08_001: The witches caused quite a few incidents while I was gone.
Affinity_Makasha_EP08_002: Go put them in line as a senior witch.
Affinity_Makasha_EP08_003: Why should I? Someone else will surely handle it. Ehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP08_004: I am so used to it by now that I have nothing left to say.
Affinity_Makasha_EP08_005: You sound as if you have endured all manner of hardship. Hmm? A quiet day makes you even more anxious?
Affinity_Makasha_EP08_006: Oh, so much has happened. I am exhausted. Truly.
Affinity_Makasha_EP08_007: Is cleaning up incidents not a Master's job? Come now, no complaining. Keep your spirits up!
Affinity_Makasha_EP09_001: Fricle's apprentice seems rather cute. What do you think?
Affinity_Makasha_EP09_002: You mean Picora? She is my apprentice now.
Affinity_Makasha_EP09_003: What? It turns out you were even better at magic than Fricle? You say it is a long story?
Affinity_Makasha_EP09_004: Why do you not take an apprentice too?
Affinity_Makasha_EP09_005: Too much trouble. Even if I had one, I would prefer the apprentice to grow up perfectly well on her own~ What is that look for?
Affinity_Makasha_EP09_006: If you are curious about the latest fashions, go visit her sometime.
Affinity_Makasha_EP09_007: What is wrong with my fashion? This was the very latest style back in my day!
Affinity_Makasha_EP10_001: Hey! Long-Limbs, what is it like having such long limbs?
Affinity_Makasha_EP10_002: You cannot scratch the crown of your head when it itches, can you? I can~
Affinity_Makasha_EP10_003: That truly is useful. But it also looks rather disturbing. It lacks a certain cuteness.
Affinity_Makasha_EP10_004: This is simply how I have always looked, so it seems normal to me.
Affinity_Makasha_EP10_005: I suppose we must look strange to you. What? You think we are cute? Hmm~
Affinity_Makasha_EP10_006: These long limbs give me an advantage in battle.
Affinity_Makasha_EP10_007: Oh? You know how to fight too? You are more useful than I expected.
Affinity_Makasha_EP11_001: In a certain, certain forest~ there once stood a gigantic leg, smiling shyly.
Affinity_Makasha_EP11_002: Is this a story about Baba?
Affinity_Makasha_EP11_003: Ehehe. Correct. You catch on quickly, do you not? You are smarter than I expected~
Affinity_Makasha_EP11_004: What kind of creature is that supposed to be?
Affinity_Makasha_EP11_005: Can you not tell just from hearing it? It is obviously about Baba! Are you usually this slow on the uptake?
Affinity_Makasha_EP11_007: A strange story?! How could you say something so cruel about my Baba?
Affinity_Makasha_EP12_001: To raise a pet house properly, you need frequent walks and regular treats.
Affinity_Makasha_EP12_002: What kind of treats does Baba like?
Affinity_Makasha_EP12_003: Baba does not like treats. She likes me. Ehehe! What is that expression? Did you not ask what she likes?
Affinity_Makasha_EP12_004: Did you not mean regular walks and frequent treats?
Affinity_Makasha_EP12_005: What modifier comes before a word is unimportant. What matters is the speaker's intention.
Affinity_Makasha_EP12_006: Most people do not have a pet house...
Affinity_Makasha_EP12_007: Hmm. How unfortunate for them all. A pet house is such a wonderful thing. Ehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP13_001: Fate can sometimes arrive without warning.
Affinity_Makasha_EP13_002: That is so accurate that I am rather taken aback.
Affinity_Makasha_EP13_003: I know perfectly well what you think of me, Master. But I am far more than you imagine, you know? Ehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP13_005: That is quite a good reaction. You defied my expectations. Ehehe. You truly are entertaining!
Affinity_Makasha_EP13_006: Enough noise. You clean up the glass you broke.
Affinity_Makasha_EP13_007: Tsk. So this method does not work. Then I shall flee! Ehehe, you can do the cleaning yourself, Long-Limbs!
Affinity_Makasha_EP14_001: What do you think of resisting because one cannot accept a fate that has already reached its conclusion?
Affinity_Makasha_EP14_002: I do not think you can force someone to accept it.
Affinity_Makasha_EP14_003: Are you taking a neutral position, or are you unable to give up anything? Sometimes a choice must be made.
Affinity_Makasha_EP14_004: Would it not depend on what kind of fate it is?
Affinity_Makasha_EP14_005: Judging according to the circumstances is indeed a sound way to solve a problem. Fate changes depending on the choice you make. Ehehe.
Affinity_Makasha_EP14_006: ...Have you ever brought a story to a hasty conclusion?
Affinity_Makasha_EP14_007: ...Tsk. You are a perceptive one. Yes, that is why. Why can one not accept the end of a story?!
Affinity_Makasha_EP15_001: Ugh... I have no energy. Is it because my skin turned pale?
Affinity_Makasha_EP15_002: At times like this, nothing beats Posher's special potion.
Affinity_Makasha_EP15_003: Kyah! I do not need that rubbish! Y-you are not friendly with that swindler, are you? Hmm?!
Affinity_Makasha_EP15_004: Make sure you take your vitamin tablets.
Affinity_Makasha_EP15_005: Vitamin tablets? Would it not be better to eat UFC fried carrots instead? Those contain vitamins too, after all.
Affinity_Makasha_EP15_006: I will make you something energizing.
Affinity_Makasha_EP15_007: Ehehe, let me see what you can do. Go prepare a fine energizing meal for me~
Affinity_Makasha_EP16_001: Ehehe! Hehe... Ehehehe! It truly is entertaining!
Affinity_Makasha_EP16_003: What? Why are you looking at me like that? That expression put me off, so I will not show you even if you are curious.
Affinity_Makasha_EP16_005: Hmm? Why, are you curious? Interested? It is a new story I wrote, and I will show it to you alone. Ehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP16_007: Ehehe, hehe! Ah~ This is entertaining. Ahem~ Good, then the development will go like this... Hmm? What are you looking at? Have you never seen a witch write before?
Affinity_Makasha_EP17_001: I encountered some fascinating stories in Monatium.
Affinity_Makasha_EP17_003: Huh... Thank you for the compliment. I never thought I would live to see the day Long-Limbs complimented me.
Affinity_Makasha_EP17_004: You find the strangest things fascinating.
Affinity_Makasha_EP17_005: I was away for quite a long time, you know. There are even exotic species now... Of course I find it all fascinating. Hmm?
Affinity_Makasha_EP17_006: Stories from Earth are entertaining, are they not?
Affinity_Makasha_EP17_007: Yes, they were more entertaining than I expected. But I found the stories of the exotic species even more fascinating. Ehehe. They have quite an interesting history!
Affinity_Makasha_EP18_001: I heard there is a ghost who reads fortunes about fate.
Affinity_Makasha_EP18_002: Do you not weave fate yourself?
Affinity_Makasha_EP18_003: Ehehe! Exactly. Divining fate and weaving fate are entirely different domains!
Affinity_Makasha_EP18_005: Really? Hmm, now I am quite interested. I wonder whether the story I changed is unfolding properly. Perhaps I should have my fortune read too.
Affinity_Makasha_EP18_006: Both of you, stop going on about fate.
Affinity_Makasha_EP18_007: Does Long-Limbs not believe in fate? Everyone has a fate. Rejecting it is hardly a proper attitude, is it?
Affinity_Makasha_EP19_001: When coincidences overlap, they become inevitability, and when inevitabilities accumulate, they become fate.
Affinity_Makasha_EP19_003: If your sensibilities end there... well, perhaps that too is your fate. Ehehe!
Affinity_Makasha_EP19_004: And you are trying to change that fate.
Affinity_Makasha_EP19_005: Ehehe. Exactly. I will change fate. If the gods have ordained it, I need only shatter it.
Affinity_Makasha_EP19_006: You were complaining about the side dishes. Where did this nonsense suddenly come from?
Affinity_Makasha_EP19_007: Ah~ Long-Limbs. You have no sense of romance at all. Hmm? Is complaining about the side dishes truly important right now? Hmm? Is that what you think?
Affinity_Makasha_EP20_001: Oh? Who were you again? You look strange.
Affinity_Makasha_EP20_002: I am Long-Limbs, at your service.
Affinity_Makasha_EP20_003: Ehehe. You secretly rather like that name too, do you not? Right? If you like it, I am satisfied as well.
Affinity_Makasha_EP20_004: You look strange too, you know.
Affinity_Makasha_EP20_005: Only an amateur answers a question with another question. Therefore, you are an amateur. Ehehe. You lost to me, understand?
Affinity_Makasha_EP20_006: I am merely a passing Master.
Affinity_Makasha_EP20_007: You were not passing by. Were you not here cooking? I know I say whatever comes to mind, but that does not mean you should too, does it?
